roofing.intro: Running a roofing business means pricing tear-off, underlayment, flashing, and ventilation by the square while keeping crews, dumpsters, and weather windows on track. This classroom covers the estimating, sales, and safety habits that turn roofing bids into well-run, profitable jobs.

concrete.intro: Concrete work runs on excavation, base material, forms, reinforcement, and finishing, all measured in cubic yards and square feet with weather and cure time shaping every day.
